name: delegate-open-widget-inline
description: An intent-only tool row keeps visual order intent text → Open → chevron, with one overlay disclosure trigger and valid sibling controls. Open shares line 1, is measured adjacent to the TEXT edge (never a chevron-unioned edge), and precedes the chevron. Visible content is flex:0 1 auto with a max-width reserving Open, chevron, and both gaps: removing the reservation wraps the trailing items, while restoring flex-grow springs them away from the text.

mutation.declaration: toolcallitem.module.css: .intentTriggerContent max-width removed; separately flex:0 1 auto changed to flex:1 1 0
mutation.note: Without the clamp the long-intent fixtures fail sameLine. With flex-grow restored the short fixtures fail text-edge adjacency. Both mutations were reverified after the text → Open → chevron restructure.
